metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure ai-chat from .claude/orrery/plan.json; every edge is inferred from call sites. # Left out on purpose: AI config CRUD and key encryption, the GET /api/ai/tools manifest load, # rate limits, 503/400 setup errors and nonbillable release detail, stop-and-clear cancellation. title: "AI chat: funding modes, quota reservation and the tool loop" subtitle: Amazon Bedrock runs through the backend under a reserved quota, OpenAI and Anthropic run from the browser, and the tool loop stops after 6 model calls kind: flowchart direction: down layout: { spacing: normal } legend: { dashed: "Side call, not awaited" } groups: lane-browser: { type: lane, label: Browser (useChat), evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:110-362" } lane-backend: { type: lane, label: Backend (FastAPI), evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:60" } lane-model: type: lane label: Model providers evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:249-250", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat_bedrock.py:233"] nodes: send: shape: terminator label: User sends message in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:137-158" mode: shape: decision label: Mode and provider? in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:86-108" # resolveCredentials getkey: shape: data label: GET stored API key in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/services/api/aiConfig.ts:38-39", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/preferences_ai.py:235-279"] context: shape: process label: Build system prompt note: preferences only in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:163-167" # built once per send, cached 5 minutes (:164) # Each round calls sendChat, which dispatches on the provider; the next round comes back here, # not to the prompt step (useChat.ts:275, :338). dispatch: shape: decision label: Provider? in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:485-494", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:296"] proxy: shape: data label: POST /api/ai/bedrock/chat in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:451" funding: shape: process label: Pick funding note: personal bearer or app model in: lane-backend evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:88-104" reserve: shape: decision label: Within quota? note: reserve under user lock in: lane-backend evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:120-126", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:153-243"] bedrock: icon: aws:bedrock label: Bedrock Converse in: lane-model evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat_bedrock.py:208-233" settle: shape: process label: Settle or release in: lane-backend evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:127-151", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:265-305"] direct: shape: process label: OpenAI or Anthropic note: browser-direct in: lane-model evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:289", "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:381"] uselog: shape: data label: POST /api/ai/usage/log note: best-effort, not awaited in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:311-325", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:306"] # promise not awaited, .catch only align: proxy tooluse: shape: decision label: tool_use? in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:334-337" # tests stopReason only # Plan lane was lane-backend; drawn as the browser's call (like proxy and uselog) so the # 6-round loop stays in one lane (7 crossings -> 2). The note keeps the backend execution. tools: shape: predefined label: POST /api/ai/tools/execute note: parallel, run user-scoped on the backend in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:344-359", "frontend/src/lib/chatTools.ts:40", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_tools.py:56-98"] # The limit is checked at the start of the next round, after the tools ran (useChat.ts:273, :338). rounds: shape: decision label: Rounds left? note: max 6 model calls in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:294", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:361", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:14"] answer: shape: terminator label: Show final answer in: lane-browser evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:334-336" capped: shape: terminator label: Stop after 6 rounds in: lane-browser evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:14", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:274-284"] # MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS quota: shape: terminator label: 429 quota exhausted in: lane-browser evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:163", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:217"] edges: - { from: send, to: mode, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:161" } - { from: mode, to: context, label: any Bedrock mode, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:92-105" } - { from: mode, to: getkey, label: BYOK OpenAI or Anthropic, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:103-106" } - { from: getkey, to: context, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:161-167" } - { from: context, to: dispatch, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:170-178" } - { from: dispatch, to: proxy, label: Bedrock, evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:451", "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:488"] } - { from: dispatch, to: direct, label: OpenAI or Anthropic, evidence: ["frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:486-487", "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:289", "frontend/src/lib/chatAdapters.ts:381"] } - { from: proxy, to: funding, label: JWT, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:77-94" } - { from: funding, to: reserve, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:106-126" } - { from: reserve, to: quota, label: "no", evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:153-163", "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_usage.py:217"] } - { from: reserve, to: bedrock, label: "yes, reserved", evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:127-128#_call_bedrock" } - { from: bedrock, to: settle, label: usage counters, evidence: "backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:136-151" } - { from: settle, to: tooluse, label: content blocks, evidence: ["backend/src/ledger_sync/api/ai_chat.py:152-157", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:328-334"] } - { from: direct, to: tooluse, label: content blocks, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:328-334" } - { from: direct, to: uselog, label: provider usage, line: dashed, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:311-325" } # side call, not awaited - { from: tooluse, to: answer, label: end_turn, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:334-336" } - { from: tooluse, to: tools, label: tool_use, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:339-351#executeTool" } - { from: tools, to: rounds, evidence: "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:352-361" } - { from: rounds, to: dispatch, label: "yes, add tool_result", evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:352-361", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:296"] } - { from: rounds, to: capped, label: "no, 6 used", evidence: ["frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:294", "frontend/src/components/chat/useChat.ts:274-284"] }

svg.title: AI chat: funding modes, quota reservation and the tool loop
svg.desc: AI chat: funding modes, quota reservation and the tool loop. 18 components in 3 groups. Connections: User sends message to Mode and provider?; Mode and provider? to Build system prompt (any Bedrock mode); Mode and provider? to GET stored API key (BYOK OpenAI or Anthropic); GET stored API key to Build system prompt; Build system prompt to Provider?; Provider? to POST /api/ai/bedrock/chat (Bedrock); Provider? to OpenAI or Anthropic (OpenAI or Anthropic); POST /api/ai/bedrock/chat to Pick funding (JWT); Pick funding to Within quota?; Within quota? to 429 quota exhausted (no); Within quota? to Bedrock Converse (yes, reserved); Bedrock Converse to Settle or release (usage counters); Settle or release to tool_use? (content blocks); OpenAI or Anthropic to tool_use? (content blocks); OpenAI or Anthropic to POST /api/ai/usage/log (provider usage); tool_use? to Show final answer (end_turn); tool_use? to POST /api/ai/tools/execute (tool_use); POST /api/ai/tools/execute to Rounds left?; Rounds left? to Provider? (yes, add tool_result); Rounds left? to Stop after 6 rounds (no, 6 used).

text.tspan: AI CHAT: FUNDING MODES, QUOTA RESERVATION AND THE TOOL LOOP
Amazon Bedrock runs through the backend under a reserved quota, OpenAI and Anthropic run from the browser, and the tool loop stops after 6 model
